counterexample.actual_registered_driver_passed_expressi: result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun == EXPECTED_TESTS and (not result.failures) and (not result.errors) and (not result.skipped) and (not result.expectedFailures) and (not result.unexpectedSuccesses) and source_unchanged and inputs_unchanged
counterexample.explanation: A new unregistered test.py file added after preflight and before completion is outside both completion inventories. The exact current test names differ, but the registered passed expression still evaluates true.

finding.gap: The completion guard recomputes production source_inventory and hashes only previously selected411 names. Production source_inventory excludes tests, and no current tests/**/*.py name inventory is recomputed after suite execution.
finding.minimum_correction: Recompute the full tests/**/*.py name/hash inventory at completion and require equality with the frozen test_hashes; include its actual unchanged observation in the run result. Preserve all other guards and claims.
finding.required_predicate: Exact production/source/test names and hashes unchanged throughout qualification; no test changes authorized.
